title: Change the homepage visual direction
context: The owner rejected the basic homepage and supplied a reference after selecting a change of direction.
options: Continue the original Annotated visual direction
choice: Use a grid canvas, framed mono identity, a separate introduction margin and asymmetrically placed, project-specific typographic covers.
tradeoff: Original typographic covers distinguish the four projects before approved application captures are available; they communicate project identity and do not imply an application screenshot.
